name: TransIndia Real Estate Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2021, Transindia Real Estate Ltd is in the business of Leasing of land and Commercial Properties, Logistics Park, Warehousing, 
 Real estate development and leasing 
 activities, Engineering and equipment 
 hiring solutions and other related 
 businesses[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
TREL is an demerged entity from Allcargo Group. It is a key player in industrial & logistics real estate sector with real estate footprint across sectors like warehousing, ICD/CFS, etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.52 times its book value
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 3.45% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.52.2 Cr.
